_schema.doc: Hand-curated census of the upstream public surface (ticket #15 on wayfinder map #14). Keyed by upstream export name; every name in parity/layer0-api/upstream.json must appear exactly once, and no name may appear that is not in it — parity/census/build.mjs enforces both.

kind.enum-value: TS enum — a runtime object AND a type upstream
kind.callback: function type the library invokes on user-supplied handlers
kind.data: data shape crossing the library boundary
kind.options: config/options record consumed by a value export
kind.instance-api: method or bundle on ReactFlowInstance / viewport helpers
kind.internal-type: type with no consumer-facing runtime shadow

mechanism.oracle: Layer 1 differential — same input through PSFlow and vendored upstream JS
mechanism.dual-run-dom: mount both, drive both, diff DOM
mechanism.dual-run-props: mount a probe component in both, compare the props object it receives
mechanism.dual-run-hook: mount a probe component in both that calls the hook, compare the returned value
mechanism.dual-run-callback: drive both, record callback invocations and payloads, compare
mechanism.dual-run-api: call the same imperative method on both instances, compare return and effect
mechanism.dual-run-value: import the symbol from both and compare the runtime value directly
mechanism.none: no runtime existence on either side — Layer 0 name presence is the whole story

gates.L0: implicit for every row — npm run parity:api, name presence only
gates.L0-props: npm run parity:api prop-member diff (name-only, no member types)
gates.L2: npm run test:smoke — a spec asserts this directly
gates.L2-indirect: npm run test:smoke — mounted or traversed, but nothing specific to it is asserted

Background: Renders-behind assertion only; no variant/gap/size/offset coverage.
BaseEdge: path, interactionWidth and markers asserted by generic-edges.
BezierEdge: getBezierPath is oracled; the component is only rendered as the fixture's default edge type.
ControlButton: Rendered inside Controls; the exported component with custom children is never mounted.
Controls: Renders + zoom-in click changes the transform.
EdgeText: Never mounted. The dual-run spike found EdgeLabelOptions entirely absent from PSFlow — this component is the surface that gap lands on.
EdgeToolbar: getEdgeToolbarTransform is oracled; the component is never mounted.
MiniMap: Renders + clickable only; no node-rendering, mask or pan/zoom coverage.
MiniMapNode: Not exported by PSFlow at all (allowlisted). A JS consumer importing it gets undefined.
NodeResizeControl: Never mounted. Known-wrong — ticket 073 (XYResizer drag lifecycle).
NodeToolbar: getNodeToolbarTransform oracled; positioning and default behaviour asserted by generic-node-toolbar.
Panel: Mounted by the ColorMode fixture; only the colorMode class on the wrapper is asserted, nothing about Panel itself.
ReactFlow: The most-covered export — nodes, edges, pane, props specs all drive it.
ReactFlowProvider: Mounted; no assertion is specific to it.
StepEdge: Upstream StepEdge is SmoothStepEdge at borderRadius 0, which the oracle domain covers; component never mounted.
BackgroundVariant: Upstream runtime enum object, from @xyflow/react rather than @xyflow/system. Crossed by the boundary module (stage 1) as a frozen object; nothing gates the value yet — surface parity's deep-equal against upstream is the plan.
ConnectionLineType: Upstream runtime enum object. Crossed by the boundary module (stage 1); nothing gates the value yet. Note Bezier is the string "default", not "bezier" — the one member here a hand-written expectation would plausibly get wrong.
ConnectionMode: Upstream runtime enum object. Crossed by the boundary module (stage 1); nothing gates the value yet.
MarkerType: Upstream runtime enum object. Crossed by the boundary module (stage 1); nothing gates the value yet. The marker *strings* are gated (getMarkerId under L1, marker-start/end under L2) but the exported object is not.
PanOnScrollMode: Upstream runtime enum object. Crossed by the boundary module (stage 1); nothing gates the value yet.
Position: Upstream runtime enum object. Crossed by the boundary module (stage 1); nothing gates the value yet.
ResizeControlVariant: Upstream runtime enum object. Crossed by the boundary module (stage 1); nothing gates the value yet.
SelectionMode: Upstream runtime enum object. Crossed by the boundary module (stage 1); nothing gates the value yet.
getNodesBounds: Deferred by ticket 059 — needs node dimensions + optional NodeLookup translation.
getViewportForBounds: Oracled by ticket 030: the fitView zoom formula agrees with upstream, so the spike's 1.03145-vs-1.05466 gap came from the inputs, not the arithmetic. Also traversed by fitView in the smoke fixtures, where nothing about its result is asserted.
addEdge: Pure, and oracle-able today with the OracleEdge translation that already exists. Listed in no ticket — not in 059's covered, deferred, or out-of-scope sets.
applyEdgeChanges: Pure and oracle-able today. Listed in no ticket.
applyNodeChanges: Pure and oracle-able today. Listed in no ticket.
reconnectEdge: Pure and oracle-able today. Listed in no ticket.
isEdge: Pure and oracle-able today. Listed in no ticket.
isNode: Pure and oracle-able today. Listed in no ticket.
useKeyPress: Four test-debt rows (077: #5090, #5118, #5263, #4880) land on this hook's focus handling.
useNodesState: One test-debt row (078: #5120, fitView for uncontrolled flows).
useReactFlow: The whole imperative API hangs off this hook; four test-debt rows (078: #5276, #5723, #5722, #5012) land on it.
Align: getNodeToolbarTransform takes align; toolbar positioning asserted.
BaseEdgeProps: interactionWidth and path exercised via the fixture edges.
BezierPathOptions: curvature swept by the getBezierPath property.
BuiltInEdge: Type-only both sides; PSFlow does not model it (allowlisted). Ruled out of scope on the map — issue #17.
BuiltInNode: Type-only both sides; PSFlow does not model it (allowlisted). Ruled out of scope on the map — issue #17.
ColorMode: generic-props asserts the light and dark wrapper classes.
Connection: click-connect asserts an edge appears; the onConnect payload shape is never inspected.
ConnectionLineComponent: Upstream component-type alias; PSFlow does not model it (allowlisted). Out of scope — issue #17.
ConnectionLineComponentProps: The connection line is never rendered by any fixture.
ControlProps: PSFlow renames it ControlsProps; cancelled on both sides by the allowlist. Type-only, so the rename cannot reach a JS consumer.
Edge: Selection, class, style, hidden, animated, zIndex, aria-label and deletion all asserted by generic-edges.
EdgeAddChange: Constructor of the PS EdgeChange sum type. No gate inspects change shapes — smoke.spec.ts asserts onNodesChange fires and explicitly avoids depending on the change shape.
EdgeComponentWithPathOptions: PSFlow does not model it (allowlisted). Out of scope — issue #17.
EdgeLabelOptions: Found entirely absent from PSFlow by the dual-run spike (issue #16) and recorded in the divergence backlog (issue #22). Previously unlisted anywhere.
EdgeMarker: getMarkerId oracled; marker-start/marker-end URLs asserted by generic-edges.
EdgeProps: Prop-member names gated by Layer 0 (ticket 071 renamed edgeType to type). No probe component reads the props object at runtime — unlike NodeProps.
EdgeRemoveChange: Constructor of the PS EdgeChange sum type.
EdgeReplaceChange: Constructor of the PS EdgeChange sum type.
EdgeSelectionChange: Constructor of the PS EdgeChange sum type.
EdgeTypes: PSFlow renames it EdgeTypesMap; type-only, so the rename cannot reach a JS consumer.
EdgeWrapperProps: Internal wrapper; observable only as the DOM it produces.
FitView: fitView runs in the NodeProps probe fixture, but no assertion targets the resulting viewport. The spike's fitView zoom divergence lives here.
GetBezierPathParams: PSFlow has BezierPathParams but does not re-export it through the React barrel (allowlisted).
GetMiniMapNodeAttribute: MiniMap-internal accessor type; not modelled. Out of scope — issue #17.
GetSmoothStepPathParams: PSFlow has SmoothStepPathParams but does not re-export it (allowlisted).
GetStraightPathParams: PSFlow has StraightPathParams but does not re-export it (allowlisted).
HandleProps: connectable=false and handle position attributes asserted.
HandleType: Surfaces as data-handlepos / handle classes, which the connect specs locate on.
KeyCode: Delete-key presses drive the deletion specs, but only the default key codes.
MiniMapNodes: Component exists in PSFlow but is not in the public barrel (allowlisted, ticket 058).
MiniMapProps: MiniMap is mounted with every prop Nothing; no prop is asserted.
NoConnection: Nullary constructor of the PS ConnectionState, not a standalone type (allowlisted, ticket 054).
Node: Selection, drag, delete, hidden, class, style all asserted by generic-nodes.
NodeAddChange: Constructor of the PS NodeChange sum type.
NodeChange: smoke.spec.ts asserts onNodesChange fires and states outright that it avoids depending on the NodeChange shape. The shape is ungated.
NodeDimensionChange: Constructor of the PS NodeChange sum type.
NodePositionChange: Constructor of the PS NodeChange sum type; the change fired by every node drag, and its shape is ungated.
NodeProps: The one type with a real runtime probe: node-props.spec.ts mounts a custom node and reads the props object. Ticket 069 closed the xPos/yPos rename here after it survived from 12.3.5 as a printed-not-failed diff.
NodeRemoveChange: Constructor of the PS NodeChange sum type.
NodeReplaceChange: Constructor of the PS NodeChange sum type.
NodeResizerProps: NodeResizer is never mounted and is known-wrong (073).
NodeSelectionChange: Constructor of the PS NodeChange sum type.
NodeToolbarProps: position, align and offset all driven by generic-node-toolbar.
NodeTypes: PSFlow renames it NodeTypesMap. A custom nodeTypes map is mounted by the NodeProps probe; the custom-default fallback is known-wrong (ticket 075).
NodeWrapperProps: Internal wrapper; observable as the .react-flow__node DOM the node specs assert on.
OnConnect: Wired in the smoke fixture and observed only as 'an edge appeared'.
OnError: One test-debt row (076: #5052, error when dragging an uninitialized node).
OnMoveEnd: One test-debt row (078: #5547, always call onMoveEnd when onMoveStart was called).
OnNodeDrag: One test-debt row (076: #5450, call onNodeDrag while autopan is ongoing).
OnNodesChange: smoke.spec.ts asserts it fires on drag — the only callback with a direct assertion, and it checks arity, not payload.
PanelPosition: The ColorMode fixture mounts a TopRight panel; position is not asserted. Two test-debt rows (079: #5252, #5362).
ReactFlowActions: Store type; not surfaced by PSFlow (allowlisted, ticket 058).
ReactFlowInstance: The entire imperative API — zoomIn/zoomOut/setViewport/screenToFlowPosition/toObject/updateNode/deleteElements — is reachable by no gate. Six test-debt rows land here.
ReactFlowProps: Prop-member names gated by Layer 0; a minority of members (selectable/draggable/deletable/connectable/minZoom/maxZoom/panOnScroll/defaultViewport/autoPan*/colorMode/nodeTypes) are driven by the smoke specs. The gate is name-only — a member whose type changed upstream still passes.
ReactFlowState: Observable through useStore selectors; no gate uses one.
ReactFlowStore: Store type; not surfaced by PSFlow (allowlisted, ticket 058).
Rect: Shape marshalled by the geometry properties.
ResizeControlLineProps: Not modelled by PSFlow (allowlisted). Out of scope — issue #17.
ResizeControlProps: Not modelled by PSFlow (allowlisted). Out of scope — issue #17.
SelectionRect: Shift-drag multi-select is asserted by its effect (nodes selected), not by the rect.
SmoothStepPathOptions: borderRadius, offset and stepPosition swept by the getSmoothStepPath property.
SnapGrid: Marshalled by the snapPosition and pointToRendererPoint properties.
Transform: Marshalled by pointToRendererPoint/rendererPointToPoint; the viewport transform string is read by the pane specs.
Viewport: Pan, wheel-zoom, minZoom, maxZoom and initial viewport asserted by the pane specs, via the transform string.
ViewportHelperFunctionOptions: Carries the ease/interpolate members from upstream #5276 — the test-debt row ticket 078 flags as most worth attention.
ZIndexMode: Four z-index assertions in generic-edges, including the two sub-flow cases.
